svg.title: Marginal Gains Workshop Board
svg.desc: A3 landscape workshop board covering Strategy, Outcomes, Product, Teams, Dependencies, Engineering, Delivery, and Learning. Sticky-note areas for friction points and improvement ideas. Three experiment slots for the next sprint, month or quarter.
svg.text: What 1% improvement would help us deliver customer value faster, better, and more predictably?
Inspired by Marginal Gains · Systems-Thinking Approach
“What small change could make this area 1% better in the next few weeks?”
